scenarios.explanation: A short call usually settles a disagreement faster than a long thread of comments.

writing.text: Hey, I covered the client report yesterday since it hadn't come through. No harm done, but can you give me a heads-up next time if something slips?
Could we try somewhere else this time? Happy with anything near the office.
